stage.value: transaction — placing a Buy Now order from a Live show

job.value: Confirm address, delivery and payment and place the order

arrivedFrom.value: Tapping 'Buy now' on the live show

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Order request' with the item, 'Address', 'Deal method' and 'Payment method' reads instantly as checkout.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width teal 'Place order' button is the most prominent element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Place order' and 'Add new payment method' are clear, but the 'Address' and 'Deal method' cards show no chevron or 'Change', so it's unclear whether tapping them does anything.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Deal method', 'Buyer Protection' and 'Platform fee' (with an info icon) are familiar or explained in place.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The buyer only picks quantity and a payment method, both things they know.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Fee detail sits behind the 'Platform fee' info icon; the summary is compact.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is for completing this one purchase; the seller-set deal method is shown, not asked.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Values and labels carry the screen; the only prose is the one-line consent and '1.5% convenience fee' note.
